page.description: Adélie Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An independent Linux distribution built on musl libc and Alpine's apk package tools, aimed at small and older machines with a choice of KDE, MATE, LXQt or Xfce desktops.
pros: musl libc and apk packages make it small and quick to install.
Desktop and installer images for x86_64, aarch64, armv7, ppc and ppc64.
Published SHA-512 sums for every image in one signed list.
Runs well on older, low-memory hardware.
cons: Still a beta: 1.0-beta6 is the current download.
Small package set and community compared with mainstream distributions.
musl means some prebuilt Linux software will not run.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Adélie Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the live or installer ISO to a USB stick with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick. These are beta images, so expect rough edges.
